subject: Vendor onboarding path & procurement gatekeepers — next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Caitlin Moore <caitlin.moore@helioshealth.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendor onboarding path & procurement gatekeepers — recap + asks

Hi Caitlin / Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so nothing falls through the cracks and we can align on the procurement path. Main points from our call: 

- Economic buyer: Samir (confirm) — high level ROI questions will be handled by Samir's office.
- Security checklist: Helios requires a completed vendor security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence (if available). You mentioned a security rep will own that intake.
- Procurement steps: vendor packet + W-9 uploaded to your vendor portal (you said Coupa) -> PO issuance -> 30-45 day invoice cadence (TBD).
- Pilot plan: 6-week pilot (small footprint) to validate latency and output quality; SOW will capture scope and success criteria.

Action items for Helios please: 
1) Confirm the procurement contact who will create the vendor record in Coupa and the expected lead time for PO issuance.
2) Send the name/email of the legal person who will review the SOW / T&Cs (we can pre-send a redline-friendly SOW).
3) Any specific billing constraints (PO number prefix, invoice routing address, remit-to, 3rd-party tax forms).

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (checklist we use to speed vendor intake).

Next suggested step: 30-minute follow-up on Thursday to walk procurement through the checklist and share a draft SOW. If that works I can send a calendar invite and a DocuSign draft to expedite.

Thanks — look forward to closing the loop.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Caitlin Moore <caitlin.moore@helioshealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helioshealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding path & procurement gatekeepers — recap + asks

Thanks for the recap, Aditya — useful. A few clarifications from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement intake: yes, we use Coupa. I (Caitlin) manage vendor onboarding. Typical lead time from complete packet -> PO is 4–6 weeks but can compress if we have an approved budget line and the business owner signs off.
- Required docs: W-9, vendor questionnaire (we'll send our template), insurance certificate, and copy of SOW.
- Legal review: please send the SOW redline-ready to legal@helioshealth.com. Our legal lead is M. Gonzalez; they will triage commercial vs. security redlines.
- Billing: Invoices must include the Helios PO number and be sent to ap-invoices@helioshealth.com.

A couple of asks from our side: 
1) Can you provide a one-page pricing summary for the pilot (per-seat vs. per-token estimates and an expected spend range)?
2) Please confirm Redwood's SOC2 status and provide any recent audit summary (we do accept completed questionnaires in lieu of full reports in initial intake).

If you send the SOW and the one-pager by EOD Wednesday we can aim to start the vendor creation next week.

—Caitlin
Caitlin Moore | Sr. Procurement Manager
Helios Health
caitlin.moore@helioshealth.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding path & procurement gatekeepers — recap + asks

Thanks for the thread — good capture. A couple internal notes and a proposed playbook to move faster: 

- Aditya: prioritize sending the pricing one-pager (simple expected spend ranges for the pilot + burst scenario) and the SOW draft to Caitlin/Legal by EOD today. Make the SOW explicitly redline-friendly (track changes + a summary of non-negotiables).
- Marissa: can you prepare a short security packet: SOC2 status, contact for SOC2 questions, and a brief note on data handling & retention (we'll attach that to the vendor packet).
- Internal escalation: if legal requests changes that materially affect pricing or SLA, flag me and we'll triage with the customer success and sales leadership.

Suggested timeline to propose to Helios: 
1) Wed (today): send SOW + pricing one-pager + security packet.
2) Thu: 30-min call with Caitlin & legal triage (if needed) to walk Coupa fields and confirm required docs.
3) Week 1–2: vendor creation in Coupa; Week 3–6: PO issuance and formal pilot kickoff.

Also include a brief clause in the SOW for an initial 6-week pilot capped at an agreed spend so procurement has clarity on exposure.

I’ll join the Coupa walkthrough if it helps speed approvals.

—Irene
Irene Choi | Sales Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Caitlin Moore <caitlin.moore@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helioshealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, legal@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding path & procurement gatekeepers — recap + asks

Hi Caitlin / Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Irene's note, attaching the SOW draft (Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.docx) and a one-page pricing summary. Also attaching our vendor checklist to populate Coupa faster.

Key points in the SOW: 
- Pilot scope: access to hosted inference endpoints for up to 3 engineering users, 100k tokens total cap for the 6-week pilot.
- Success criteria: latency < 300ms P95 for standard requests; quality checks on 3 canonical prompt sets.
- Pricing: fixed pilot fee option (USD 12,000) or usage estimate (approx. USD 8k–16k depending on token usage).
- Termination: 14-day termination notice during pilot; standard T&Cs deferred until post-pilot negotiations.

Next steps proposed: 
1) Caitlin — if Coupa intake requires specific file naming or fields, let me know and I will reformat.
2) Samir — can you confirm whether budget is approved for the pilot lane or whether we should request a purchase order against a general innovation budget?
3) Legal — I'll upload the SOW to DocuSign once we have any immediate redlines; feel free to send comments to legal@helioshealth.com.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://hubspot.com/deals/HL-2027-0443; Draft SOW (DocuSign prep) — https://www.docusign.com/helloworld/signer?envelopeId=5f9e8a

If Thursday at 11am ET works, I’ll set a short Coupa-walkthrough invite with myself, Caitlin, and Marissa to fill in the vendor packet live.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the vendor record created so we can kick the pilot.

—Aditya
